title: The Snail (The Shell of Pride)
summary: The snail crawled along the gravel path, sneering at the busy bees and fragrant roses: "What fools! Working and blooming for others! I live for myself alone within my shell!"...
full_text:
The snail crawled along the gravel path, sneering at the busy bees and fragrant roses: "What fools! Working and blooming for others! I live for myself alone within my shell!"

A carriage rolled along the driveway. The iron wheel crushed the haughty snail to powder, while the roses bloomed on, scenting the summer breeze with love.
moral: Withdrawing into the shell of arrogant isolation leaves one dead to the beauty of the world.
